title: CLAUDE.md
text: get_cmhc() single entry point fetching data. call specifies CMHC table four-part key survey → series → dimension → breakdown (plus geoFilter), Census geo_uid. flow: Look matching row table registry via list_cmhc_tables(short=FALSE), validating key part turn producing progressively specific error messages. Translate Census geo_uid CMHC’s internal geography parameters (geography_id, geography_type_id, MetId) via cmhc_region_params_from_census(). Named geo_uid vectors (e.g. c(CMA=..., Neighbourhood=...)) select sub-metro regions. Apply table-code special cases (national-level tables, Starts (SAAR) geography rules). POST form .../ExportTable requesting exportType="csv", writing per-query cache file tempdir() keyed digest::digest(query_params) (skip network cached unless refresh=TRUE). Parse CMHC CSV (note: latin1-encoded, UTF-8; comma thousands-separators inside $ amounts; —/++/n//** sentinel values handled parse_numeric()), split value columns paired - Quality columns, pivot_longer tidy long tibble. Region/title/subtitle CSV header become tibble attr()s. Two request shapes: snapshot (pass year/month/quarter) vs time series (breakdown="Historical Time Periods", optionally frequency). Frequency inferred whichever temporal argument supplied.

Adding support new CMHC table means adding rows . list_cmhc_*() discovery functions (_surveys, _series, _dimensions, _breakdowns, _filters) interactive select_cmhc_table() query builder read registry. list_cmhc_periods() exception — probes live server available time periods.

title: CLAUDE.md
text: Converts Census GeoUIDs CMHC’s internal geocodes CMA / CSD / CT / Zone / Neighbourhood levels, using bundled translation tables. Geographic level inferred number characters id. get_cmhc_geography() / download_geographies() fetch large (~55 MB) CMHC-specific spatial files (Survey Zones, Neighbourhoods) public S3 bucket plain HTTPS (via httr S3 REST list/get API — see list_s3_bucket_keys()) CMHC_CACHE_PATH cache directory (managed R/user_settings.R). cache spatial geographies — ordinary get_cmhc() data uses tempdir().

title: Access CMHC data via the HMIP. — get_cmhc
text: survey CMHC survey, one "Scss", "Rms", "Srms", "Seniors",  consult `list_cmhc_surveys()` possible values. (surveys data series may supported future versions.) series CMHC data series survey, consult `list_cmhc_series()` possible values. dimension dimension show results, consult `list_cmhc_dimensions()` possible values. breakdown geographic breakdown, one "Survey Zones", "Census Subdivision", "Neighbourhoods", "Census Tracts", querying data snapshot time "Historical Time Periods" querying time series data. geographic breakdowns available series. returns data frame CMHC data, tile subtitle set attributes.  Consult `list_cmhc_breakdowns()` possible values. geoFilter optional geographic type, relevaent provincial Canada-wide tables. Options "Default" (default) considers accesses default tables used data metro area finer geographies. designaters useful used conjunction `geo_uid`s provinces Canada. Specifying ""  give data sub-regions, "Metro", considers data metro areas, "50k" "10k", considers data metro areas agglomerations least 50k 10k people, respectively. geo_uid Census geographic identifier query data. Can census tract, census subdivision, census metropolitan area. year optional, needed querying data snapshot time. quarter optional, needed querying data snapshot time querying quarterly data. month optional, needed querying data snapshot time. frequency optional, needed querying time series data, one "Monthly", "Quarterly" "Annual". filters optional list filters, consult `list_cmhc_filters()` possible values. refresh optional, re-download data CMHC instead using copy cached R session's temporary directory. Defaults `FALSE`.
